from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [list(row) for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Full uniform rows/columns are the dividers between repeated panels.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    candidates = {}
    for r in row_lines:
        candidates[g[r][0]] = candidates.get(g[r][0], 0) + 1
    for c in col_lines:
        candidates[g[0][c]] = candidates.get(g[0][c], 0) + 1
    divider = max(candidates, key=candidates.get)
    rows = [r for r in row_lines if g[r][0] == divider]
    cols = [c for c in col_lines if g[0][c] == divider]
    rb = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [w]
    boxes = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1], cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])
             for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)]
    # The most common non-divider color is the empty-panel background.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row if v != divider)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    source = max(boxes, key=lambda b: sum(g[r][c] != background for r in range(b[0],b[1]) for c in range(b[2],b[3])))
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
    pattern = [(r-r0, c-c0, g[r][c]) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1) if g[r][c] != background]
    for a,b,x,y in boxes:
        if (a,b,x,y) == source:
            continue
        for dr,dc,color in pattern:
            if a+dr < b and x+dc < y:
                g[a+dr][x+dc] = color
    return g
'''
p=base/'task-4eed77c3.py'
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
